jobs.name: リンゴロン
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-resolution original RPG creature concept, one basic-form character per image, for NIHON QUEST cinematic design approval (not a 3D mesh).
Input images: Image 1 is the exact existing in-game pixel sprite and is the authority for this character's identity, silhouette, anatomy, color blocking and signature parts. Image 2 (red lion-dog) and Image 3 (wood owl) are STYLE ONLY references for matte sculpted miniature rendering, softness of forms, restrained surface texture and studio lighting. Do NOT transfer their anatomy, mane, leaf wings, eyes or color scheme onto the subject.
Primary request: Translate the existing sprite into a coherent polished three-dimensional game-character design. Preserve recognizable proportions, expression, main color areas and iconic objects; resolve low-resolution ambiguity conservatively. Smooth volumetric geometry, clean big shapes, charming but individually distinct face, low-detail sculpted materials; premium matte painted miniature feel, not 2D painting, not voxel/pixelated, not photorealistic, not plush/felt fabric.
Composition: square 1:1, SINGLE character, SINGLE full-body near-frontal three-quarter view with only slight rotation to reveal thickness; quiet neutral stance, no action pose, entire silhouette and every held object/tail/wing visible with comfortable 12% margin. Soft warm light-gray seamless studio background and subtle floor/contact shadow (hovering shadow if flying). Soft broad key light upper-left and gentle fill. Subject occupies about 75% of the image height.
Constraints: base form only, no evolutions or alternate versions, no multi-view sheet, no inset sprite, no scene, no extra characters, no title/caption/letters, no watermark or logo. Do not add accessories, gold trim, sparkles, elaborate engraving or new limbs that are not in Image 1. Dark outlines in the sprite are color boundaries, not thick outlines on the 3D render. No generic substitution with an existing franchise character.
Character-specific identity lock:
A plump red apple fairy/slime: rounded apple body with a clearly indented top and broad bottom, one short dark-brown stem and one green leaf tilted sideways; red main body, darker red underside, tiny rosy cheek spots, two simple friendly dark oval eyes with modest white highlights and a small open U-shaped smile. The apple IS its body and face, not an apple costume on an animal. Preserve its compact almost limbless silhouette; only tiny basal foot nubs if needed, no arms, no human torso. Satin-matte red finish, not a mirror-gloss fruit; no ornamental flowers or extra leaves.
jobs.visualCheck: Reviewed against sprite: distinctive silhouette, main palette and signature parts present; no apparent missing major parts, unwanted text or clipping. Candidate, not user-approved.
